_comment: The published example of the JavaScript transformation contract: one script, one input,
one expected result. It ships in railhook-common's jar rather than in either module's test
resources because it is the one fixture both call sites are checked against —
TransformParityTest in railhook-api runs it through the preview path and the one in
railhook-worker runs it through the delivery path, and they assert the same bytes.
Divergence between the two is exactly what the template language did for a year, and this
is what makes it go red instead of quiet.
The same script is the worked example on the transformations docs page, in both languages.
